## Purpose

Replace this page with a description of the analysis. This template proves
the pipeline end to end: ArcGIS REST -> `gis_adhoc_analyses` cache ->
geopandas -> Quarto page.

## Load data

```{python}
from gis_adhoc_analyses.layer_cache import ensure_layers
import geopandas as gpd

L = ensure_layers(["center_boundaries"])
centers = gpd.read_file(L["center_boundaries"])
centers.shape
```

## Preview

```{python}
centers.head()
```

```{python}
ax = centers.plot(figsize=(8, 6), edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.3)
ax.set_axis_off()
ax.set_title("WCV Centers and Regional Land Uses")
```
